title: Feature/grpc
body:
Please note https://github.com/bkneis/teleport-jobworker/pull/2 needs to be merged before this PR.

This PR implements the gRPC server and client implementing the gRPC service defined in worker.proto. After running the server the client can be used as a CLI for managing jobs. Please see the README.md for more details on how to run and test. 

Unit tests are covering the basic functionality of the server but the majority of testing is done as integration tests, where jobs are actually executed and the CLI responses are asserted. These integration tests also cover the authentication and authorization of the gRPC service.

title: Feature/lib
body:
This PR implements the golang library as designed in `docs/0001-job-worker.md`. README.md has instructions on how to run the examples and notes on testing.

Note, one deviation I made from the design was to use `io.weight` instead of `io.latency`. Unfortunately my Ubuntu 20 was built with the IO latency feature not enabled. To prevent me from having to rebuild cgroups or upgrade my system I decided to use this interface file instead. Although IO latency is the preferred method in the cgroups v2 docs the IO weight also allows us to place resource control for IO
